q2_gaps: constitutive "N of <mass>" of-phrase ("molecule of water") — it is not a possessive, part-whole, partitive, measure or nominalization-object of-phrase, so no encoding is licensed (the parse copes by fusing it into the compound kind water_molecule, which the surface does not contain)

a passive's demoted-agent "of"-phrase ("is composed of two hydrogen atoms") — the passive rule assigns the active-subject role only to a by-phrase, and the prepositional-verb rule would instead send the NP to a preposition-named oblique
notes: Giving the "composed of" NP the Agent role is a reasonable extension of the voice-alternation principle but is not literally licensed for a non-"by" phrase. Everything else follows the instruction set: universal over a verbal clause becomes a rule, the counted plural is a per-binding Skolem group with Cardinality 2, the participial "attached to" post-modifier is reified as a reduced relative, and the decomposition atoms carry definitional TVs.
